description_zh: 夜间干燥路面上，Zoox 自动驾驶 SUV（2016 Toyota Highlander，原报告车辆1）在 5th St 北向 Jesse St 附近跟车减速停车、刹车灯亮起，后方同车道的 2011 Volvo C70（原报告车辆2，行驶中、直行）以约 10 mph 追尾其左后侧；选主动驶来的后车 Volvo 为 ego 测其能否及时刹停，前车 AV 为前方减速停车 NPC。

source_snippets: A Zoox vehicle in autonomous mode was slowing to a stop with brake lights illuminated behind traffic on northbound 5th Street near Jesse Street when a vehicle behind made contact at approximately 10mph.
SECTION 3 — OTHER PARTY'S INFORMATION/VEHICLE 2: VEHICLE YEAR: 2011; MODEL: Volvo C70; ... Vehicle was: Moving checked, Stopped in Traffic unchecked.
MOVEMENT PRECEDING COLLISION: A. STOPPED — VEH 1 marked; B. PROCEEDING STRAIGHT — VEH 2 marked.
TYPE OF COLLISION: C. REAR END — VEH 1 marked, VEH 2 marked.

SECTION 2 — ACCIDENT INFORMATION/VEHICLE 1: VEHICLE YEAR: 2016; MAKE: Toyota; MODEL: Highlander ... MINOR checked ... an "X" is marked in the box at the left side of the vehicle diagram (left rear side area).
DATE OF ACCIDENT: 02/11/2023; TIME OF ACCIDENT: 06:06, AM box unchecked, PM box checked.
WEATHER: A. CLEAR — VEH 1 marked, VEH 2 marked; LIGHTING: C. DARK–STREETLIGHTS — VEH 1 marked, VEH 2 marked; ROADWAY SURFACE: A. DRY.
evidence.reason: 追尾事故：前车（Zoox AV，Toyota Highlander SUV）跟车减速停车并亮刹车灯，属 front_brake；后车（Volvo C70，行驶中直行）主动驶来追尾，属有测试价值的驾驶决策主体，故选其为 ego，其碰撞前速度由 'approximately 10mph' 换算为 4.47 m/s。前车在 ego 接近时仍在减速过程而非早已静止，故用 front_brake（'decelerating to stop' → brake_t=2.0, end_speed=0），不用 stopped_ahead。位置关系用 ahead_same_lane，碰撞为 rear end，现有词汇表可完整表达。
